tasks.label: Copy cutter_comp to GRBLHAL CutterComp Plugin repo
Copy all NC and MCU SVG outputs to GRBLHAL Misc
tasks.command: $workspace = '${workspaceFolder}'; $dataDir = Join-Path $workspace 'data'; $outputDir = Join-Path $workspace 'output'; $destination = 'D:\Repos\grblHALCutterComp\Misc'; $files = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dataDir -Filter '*.nc' -File) + @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $outputDir -Filter '*.mcu.svg' -File); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No NC or MCU SVG files found to copy.' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destination -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $files.FullName -Destination $destination -Force; Write-Host ('Copied ' + $files.Count + ' file(s) to ' + $destination + '.')
